notes: Cerca de generación (paso 8.9): la tablet sube un precio y, entre su saludo (que vio la generación de siempre) y su subida, otra PC empieza a reemplazar la nube (generation 10000000-…-000000000900, generationPrevious la anterior).

Cada upsert y lápida lleva la cerca ((SELECT Value FROM _tpvc_meta WHERE Key = 'generation') IS ?, con la generación de la tablet), así que no escribe nada (affected_row_count 0), y el SELECT de la generación al final de la petición regresa la nueva: la tablet se detiene (GENERATION_CHANGED) sin avanzar su cursor ni releer nada, y la siguiente sincronización espera a generationReady (generation-change.jsonl).

Marcadores: <time> = una hora que cambia en cada corrida, <id:N> = un GUID al azar, <nonce:N> = el InstanceNonce, <appVersion> = la versión de TPVC, <osDescription> = el sistema de la computadora que grabó. Los SyncId 10000000-0000-4000-8000-… son fijos.

stmt.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now') AS now, strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now','-5 seconds') AS wm, (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'clinicId') AS "clinicId", (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'generation') AS "generation", (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'generationReady') AS "generationReady", (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'generationPrevious') AS "generationPrevious", (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'protocol') AS "protocol", (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'minClientProtocol') AS "minClientProtocol", (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'fullUploadAtUtc') AS "fullUploadAtUtc", (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'stampsRepairedAtUtc') AS "stampsRepairedAtUtc";

INSERT INTO "Products" ("SyncId", "UpdatedAtUtc", "SyncedAtUtc", "OriginDeviceId", "Code", "CostExcludesVat", "CreatedAt", "CurrentStock", "GenericName", "IsActive", "Location", "MinStock", "Name", "Notes", "OpenedUnitsRemaining", "OptimalStock", "Presentation", "Price", "RequiresRefrigeration", "SupplierCode", "Unit", "UnitCost", "UnitsPerPackage", "UpdatedAt", "CategorySyncId") SELECT ?, ?, strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now'), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "SyncTombstones" WHERE "EntityType" = ? AND "SyncId" = ? AND "DeletedAtUtc" >= ?) AND (SELECT "Value" FROM "_tpvc_meta" WHERE "Key" = 'generation') IS ? ON CONFLICT("SyncId") DO UPDATE SET "UpdatedAtUtc" = excluded."UpdatedAtUtc", "SyncedAtUtc" = excluded."SyncedAtUtc", "OriginDeviceId" = excluded."OriginDeviceId", "Code" = excluded."Code", "CostExcludesVat" = excluded."CostExcludesVat", "CreatedAt" = excluded."CreatedAt", "CurrentStock" = excluded."CurrentStock", "GenericName" = excluded."GenericName", "IsActive" = excluded."IsActive", "Location" = excluded."Location", "MinStock" = excluded."MinStock", "Name" = excluded."Name", "Notes" = excluded."Notes", "OpenedUnitsRemaining" = excluded."OpenedUnitsRemaining", "OptimalStock" = excluded."OptimalStock", "Presentation" = excluded."Presentation", "Price" = excluded."Price", "RequiresRefrigeration" = excluded."RequiresRefrigeration", "SupplierCode" = excluded."SupplierCode", "Unit" = excluded."Unit", "UnitCost" = excluded."UnitCost", "UnitsPerPackage" = excluded."UnitsPerPackage", "UpdatedAt" = excluded."UpdatedAt", "CategorySyncId" = excluded."CategorySyncId" WHERE excluded."UpdatedAtUtc" > "Products"."UpdatedAtUtc";
